title: dodonaea viscosa var. aspleniifolia
intro: Dodonaea viscosa var. aspleniifolia, commonly known as the sticky hopbush, is a plant species within the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is said to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include soothing irritated skin, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Dodonaea viscosa var. aspleniifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
